newsitem.title: USA: Conseco on track to meet 1997 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Conseco on track to meet 1997 estimates.

text.p: Conseco Inc said its strong first quarter results put it on track to equal or exceed analyst operating earnings estimates of $2.50-$2.75 per share in 1997.
The company reported first quarter operating earnings of $0.59 a share, before one-time items, compared with the First Call consensus estimate of $0.58 a share.

"Our strong results in the first quarter demonstrate Conseco's ability to grow both internally - through the active management of new sales and in-force business - and externally through acquisitions," Conseco chairman Stephen Hilbert said.
